rubrics.justification: ICM description is reasonable and the embryo appears expanded, but the response overcalls visible hatching/TE quality from this single image and upgrades 4AA to 5AA despite the provided lab grade.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, prior IVF failure, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with prognosis, though some links are somewhat generalized.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with the implantation estimate broadly matching the favorable profile; the main issue is the unsupported stage upgrade and some overinterpretation of morphology.

Most recommendations are standard, but suggesting ERA after a single additional failed transfer and implying immunologic/thrombophilia workup relatively early is more aggressive than guideline-based routine practice; upgrading the Gardner stage also departs from strict grading conventions.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support, review of prior cycle, and contingency planning, though some suggestions are somewhat generic and not tightly prioritized.
